needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this junction to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at this junction to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at this junction to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to cross the road safely.
Install street lighting at this junction to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.
